India-UK collaboration to enhance skill set in healthcare October 9, 2026 | Friday | News Initiatives include two certificate pathways for AYUSH graduates and postgraduates Marengo Asia Hospitals and BAPIO Training Academy, in association with the Ministry of Ayush, Government of India, have announced initiatives in clinical skill upgradation of AYUSH doctors (BHMS & BAMS) at the second edition of the Indo-UK Healthcare Conclave in Delhi, India. Inaugurated by Prataprao Ganpatrao Jadhav, Minister of State, Ayush, Government of India, the Conclave focuses on enhancing the healthcare skills and strengthening continuity of care through structured education, supervised clinical training and assessment through this India–UK partnerships. The initiatives include two certificate pathways for AYUSH graduates and postgraduates which aims to strengthen their clinical skills ensuring patient safety and creating continuity of care, within the system. The AYUSH clinical-skills initiative comprises a six-month Certificate in Acute Care & Emergency Support and a six-month Certificate in Lifestyle Health & Well-Being Counselling & Practice. Both pathways are designed for AYUSH graduates and postgraduates and combine structured teaching with supervised practical training. Through these initiatives, Marengo Asia Hospitals and BAPIO Training Academy seek to establish a continuing platform for India–UK collaboration in healthcare education, clinical practice and innovation, with a shared focus on patient care. October 9, 2026 | Friday | News
Initiatives include two certificate pathways for AYUSH graduates and postgraduates
Marengo Asia Hospitals and BAPIO Training Academy, in association with the Ministry of Ayush, Government of India, have announced initiatives in clinical skill upgradation of AYUSH doctors (BHMS & BAMS) at the second edition of the Indo-UK Healthcare Conclave in Delhi, India.
Inaugurated by Prataprao Ganpatrao Jadhav, Minister of State, Ayush, Government of India, the Conclave focuses on enhancing the healthcare skills and strengthening continuity of care through structured education, supervised clinical training and assessment through this India–UK partnerships.
The initiatives include two certificate pathways for AYUSH graduates and postgraduates which aims to strengthen their clinical skills ensuring patient safety and creating continuity of care, within the system.
The AYUSH clinical-skills initiative comprises a six-month Certificate in Acute Care & Emergency Support and a six-month Certificate in Lifestyle Health & Well-Being Counselling & Practice. Both pathways are designed for AYUSH graduates and postgraduates and combine structured teaching with supervised practical training.
Through these initiatives, Marengo Asia Hospitals and BAPIO Training Academy seek to establish a continuing platform for India–UK collaboration in healthcare education, clinical practice and innovation, with a shared focus on patient care.
